map.9 个步骤能增减吗？: Can the 9 steps be added or removed?
map.checker-10 查的是最终清洁质量结果，本工具查的是作业流程是否合规；两者: checker-10 audits the final cleaning quality result, while this tool audits whether the process is compliant; only combining them covers both result and process.
map.→ 打开保洁流程标准化评估工具: -> Open the cleaning process standardisation assessment tool
map.从 SOP 制定、操作规范与检查标准三大模块共 15 项要点评估保洁流程的标准化: Evaluates how standardised the cleaning process is from 15 key points across three modules (SOP development, operating standards and inspection standards), outputting a percentage and a grade to help improve the system.
map.保洁流程标准化评估 使用指南: Cleaning process standardisation assessment user guide
map.可以。不同业态（如医院、食品厂）可增删步骤或加强制项，模板化配置即可，不必拘泥固: Yes. Different business types (such as hospitals or food plants) can add or remove steps or make items mandatory; configure the template and do not stick to a fixed 9 steps.
map.合规率低于多少要重训？: Below what compliance rate should you retrain?
map.和 checker-10 有什么区别？: What is the difference from checker-10?
map.品质审计或飞检，抽查在岗人员流程合规率，发现习惯性违规步骤。: For quality audits or unannounced inspections, spot-check the process compliance rate of on-duty staff to find habitual violations.
map.建议低于 85% 安排复训并跟进，连续两次不达标应重新评估岗位胜任力。: Below 85% it is advised to arrange retraining and follow up; two consecutive failures should trigger a reassessment of role fitness.
map.新员工上岗培训考核，以 9 步勾选结果判断是否已掌握标准动作。: New staff onboarding assessment, using the 9-step checklist result to judge whether the standard actions are mastered.
map.新项目导入标准作业流程（SOP）时，用本工具逐步行进核对，确认班组是否按规范操作: When rolling out a standard operating procedure for a new project, use this tool to check step by step and confirm whether the team works to the standard.
map.标准化程度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100%: Standardisation level = actual points earned ÷ full marks ×100%
